name: Rod Liber
bio:
Rod Liber is a highly skilled tattoo artist specializing in the traditional style, who has garnered substantial acclaim for his illustrative talents and painted works that can be viewed on his @rod_libergraphics Instagram account. He brings a deep level of professionalism to his craft, which is evident not only in the artistic finesse of his tattoos but also in the diligent upkeep of his workspace at Good Times Tattoo in Buenos Aires, ensuring clients are welcomed into a clean and hygienic environment for their ink sessions. His affiliation with the Kustom Family and his personal lifestyle as a vegetarian are testaments to his multifaceted personality and commitments both in and out of the tattooing world.
